title: Study Evaluating INS018_055 Administered Orally to Subjects With Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)

primaryEndpoints.measure: Percentage of Participants Who Had at Least 1 Treatment-emergent Adverse Event (TEAE)
primaryEndpoints.description:
TEAEs were either events with start date on or after the start of the Treatment Period and up to 17 days after EOT (end of treatment), or events with start date prior to the start of the Treatment Period whose severity worsened on or after the start of the Treatment Period and up to 17 days after EOT.

CTCAE=Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events
primaryEndpoints.timeFrame: From first dose of study drug until end of study (EOS) visit i.e. up to 13 weeks (+10 days)

title: Efficacy and Safety of REC-2282 in Patients With Progressive Neurofibromatosis Type 2 (NF2) Mutated Meningiomas

primaryEndpoints.measure: Cohort A: Number of Participants with Progression-free survival (PFS) at 6 Months
primaryEndpoints.description: In Cohort A, PFS is defined as the number of participants who are alive and progression-free at 6 months with progression defined as having an increase of 20% or more in the target tumor identified.

primaryEndpoints.measure: Cohort B: Number of Participants with PFS up to 3 years
primaryEndpoints.description: In Cohort B, PFS is defined as the time from the date of randomization until disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first.

title: Study of ABS-201 Evaluating Single and Multiple Ascending Doses in Adults With and Without Androgenetic Alopecia

primaryEndpoints.measure: Incidence rate of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) and serious TEAEs
primaryEndpoints.description: Safety assessments based on reporting of Treatment Emergent Adverse Events, together with clinically significant changes in vital signs, 12-lead ECG parameters, physical examination findings and clinical safety laboratory tests, and change in neurobehavioral symptoms (PHQ-9 and GAD-7).
primaryEndpoints.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of the Study (SAD approximately 12 months, MAD approximately 18 months)
